title: nutty springy portuguese dum bao
description: a plant-based portuguese inspired dish featuring crispy dum in a scallop shell with a nutty filling. great for a weeknight dinner or a fun snack to share with friends.

ingredients.name: thai fish sauce
ingredients.notes: use 1 tsp if you prefer less umami flavor

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use in a spray bottle for crispy dum

ingredients.name: pierce and chopped dried shiitake mushrooms

instructions: spray a scallop shell with olive oil and place the dum wrapper in it.
in a pan heat 1 tsp of olive oil over medium heat, add the garlic and ginger, and sauté until fragrant.
add the chopped kale, mushrooms, and cashews to the pan and stir fry until the kale is wilted.
